title: Midnight Craving French Injera Crepes
description: A French twist on traditional Ethiopian injera, these crepes are perfect for a midnight snack. With a hint of spice and a touch of sweetness, they're sure to satisfy your cravings.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, injera flour, and eggs.
Gradually add in the milk, whisking until the batter is smooth.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook for another minute, until the other side is lightly browned.
Repeat with the remaining batter, until all the crepes are cooked.
Serve the crepes warm, topped with molten chocolate chips and a drizzle of maple syrup.
